title: God of War TV show casts Deborah Ann Woll as Faye 🪓
subject: godofwar
description:
Does Woll returning make you more excited for the show? 👇

Deborah Ann Woll, who voiced Faye in God of War Ragnarök and leads God of War: Laufey, will play Faye in Prime Video's live-action God of War series. Dave Bautista plays Kratos, Ronald D. Moore is showrunner, and the series has a two-season order. Filming began this fall in Vancouver; no release date yet.

Sources: Deadline (Nov 23, 2026), Collider (Nov 23, 2026), Shacknews (Nov 23, 2026)
Game footage/images © Sony Interactive Entertainment.

scenes.text: Faye has her live-action actor, and it's a familiar one.
On November 23, Deadline reported that Deborah Ann Woll will play her in Prime Video's God of War series.
Woll voiced Faye in Ragnarök and leads God of War: Laufey, due May 20, 2027.
Dave Bautista plays Kratos, after Ryan Hurst left following an injury.
Ronald D. Moore runs the show, which has a two-season order. Filming began this fall in Vancouver.
